verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence describes Floot acting as an MCP *server* that external clients (Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Claude, ChatGPT) connect to (floot-docs-2, floot-docs-15, floot-docs-16, floot-docs-29, floot-probe-4) — the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Floot so Floot's own AI can use their tools. No evidence shows Floot consuming or configuring third-party MCP servers as a client.
